newsitem.title: USA: MK Rail renames itself MotivePower.
newsitem.headline: MK Rail renames itself MotivePower.

text.p: MK Rail Corp said Wednesday it will change its name to MotivePower Industries Inc beginning January 1 and begin trading under a new stock symbol, "MOPO."
MK Rail said the name change is appropriate after Morrison Knudsen Corp distributed its remaining MK Rail stock earlier this month to creditors as part of Morrison Knudsen's bankruptcy settlement.
MK Rail was incorporated in April 1993 as a Morrison Knudsen subsidiary. In April 1994 Morrison Knudsen sold 35 percent of its MK Rail stock in an initial public offering.
MK Rail said its Locomotive Group would incorporate as Boise Locomotive Co and that its MK Engine Systems Co subsidiary would change its name to Engine Systems Co.
